teaching and learning

28 Aug 2020

I’ve always wanted to teach, but unfortunately I neglected teaching opportunities in college. Through experience, I’ve also realized that you have to learn to teach, ironically.

So do I learn to teach from a teacher? Or do I self-teach teaching? I’m not sure but there definitely isn’t anyone around to teach me right now. I think I’m going to start putting some effort into growing my teaching skills. I hope my next blog post will be a product of this effort.
